subject: DevForum 2026 sponsorship: package deliverables & keynote slot clarification
messages:
From: Harper Lane <harper.lane@devforum.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.inference>
Cc: DevForum Sponsorships <sponsorships@devforum.com>
Date: 2026-01-20T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: DevForum 2026 — sponsorship package and speaking availability

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the conversation earlier — excited to have Redwood Inference in the conversation for DevForum 2026 (SF, May 11–13). I attached the standard sponsorship package (DevForum_Sponsorship_Pkg_v3.pdf) which outlines benefits for the Platinum package you asked about. Quick highlights:

- 40% larger logo on the main stage banner (Platinum)
- One 30-minute keynote session in the Leadership Track (Saturday morning)
- 10x lead-scans and contact passes for demo pod staff
- Two 10x10 premium expo booths (corner placement subject to final floorplan)
- Inclusion in the sponsor highlight email (pre-show) and attendee app listing

A couple of items we flagged for confirmation from your side: desired keynote length and speaker AV needs, and whether you plan any interactive demo that requires dedicated power/network. I've included the current floorplan (Booth_Floorplan.png) for reference.

If you can confirm by 1/28 we can hold the Leadership Track keynote slot and the corner booth placement.

Best,
Harper Lane
Senior Sponsorship Manager, DevForum
attachments: DevForum_Sponsorship_Pkg_v3.pdf, Booth_Floorplan.png
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.inference>
To: Harper Lane <harper.lane@devforum.com>
Cc: DevForum Sponsorships <sponsorships@devforum.com>
Date: 2026-01-22T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: DevForum 2026 — sponsorship package and speaking availability

Hi Harper,

Appreciate the packet — looks promising. A few clarifying questions before we move to contract:

1) Keynote timing: The packet lists a 30-minute Leadership Track keynote. Is there flexibility to extend to 40 minutes (including a 5–7 minute live Q&A)? If there's an added fee we should see that on paper.

2) Logo placement: The sheet says “40% larger” on the main stage banner. Can you confirm placement hierarchy (center-left vs. lower tier) and whether the stage backdrop is single-tier or segmented by sponsor level? We need assurance of frontline visibility for product marketing.

3) Lead sharing: How are badge scans delivered (CSV export, via app)? Is there an opt-in for full contact info or are we limited to hashed leads?

4) Demo pod power/network: We plan a short, interactive demo that streams a 10-minute model demo. Can you confirm dedicated ethernet and a single 20A circuit per pod?

5) Presentation requirements: I attached a short outline of the proposed keynote (Proposed_Presentation_Outline.docx). Any constraints on slide/video formats?

If you can answer those and send the updated floorplan with booth IDs we can expedite approval.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Platform Partnerships, Redwood Inference
attachments: Proposed_Presentation_Outline.docx
From: DevForum Sponsorships <sponsorships@devforum.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.inference>
Cc: Harper Lane <harper.lane@devforum.com>
Date: 2026-01-28T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: DevForum 2026 — sponsorship package and speaking availability

Hi Vivek — thanks for the detailed questions, answering inline below.

1) Keynote timing: The standard Leadership Track slot is 30 minutes. We can offer a 40-minute slot (30 + 10 Q&A) for an incremental fee of $5,000 to cover schedule/timekeeper adjustments. If you confirm, we’ll lock that on the schedule.

2) Logo placement: Platinum sponsors receive prime center-left placement on the main backdrop; it is a two-tier backdrop (headliner tier + supporting tier). Platinum will be in the headliner tier. We can guarantee front-row visibility (center-left) for Platinum sponsors in stage renderings.

3) Lead sharing: We provide a CSV export of badge scans and app opt-ins post-event (GDPR-compliant). By default we share contact info for those who opted in; hashed-only for non-opt-ins. If you need a managed lead pass list earlier, we can arrange a daily export during the show with a DPA amendment.

4) Demo pod: We can provide one dedicated 20A circuit per pod and wired ethernet. Please provide IP addressing needs a week prior; our on-site tech will coordinate.

5) Slides/video: We accept PPTX or PDF; videos should be MP4 H.264. Presentations are uploaded to our speaker portal 48 hours before the session — we’ll provide the link when the contract is signed.

Attached is an updated floorplan with provisional booth IDs. If you want the 40-minute slot we’ll add the fee line to the SOW and send the redline-ready contract.

Best,
DevForum Sponsorships Team
attachments: Booth_Floorplan_v2.png
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-02-02T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: RE: DevForum 2026 — internal alignment on package

Vivek — quick internal note before you reply to Harper:

Summary of their answers: 40-minute slot available for +$5k, front-left center-stage placement guaranteed for Platinum, CSV exports for opted-in leads, dedicated 20A and ethernet for demo pods, PPTX/MP4 accepted. Booth IDs are provisionally assigned in the v2 floorplan.

Recommendation: accept the 40-minute slot (Q&A adds value, aligns with our GTM messaging), finalize SOW with the +$5k fee, and push for a clause that Redwood is listed as a “Headliner — Lead Platform Sponsor” in the attendee app and pre-show email (this protects logo prominence beyond the stage). Also request daily lead exports during the show (DPA amendment) so CS can triage inbound interest.

If you want I’ll draft the one-paragraph ask for the SOW and chase the DPA addendum with legal. Marissa can book the travel and the demo staging once we sign.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Field Marketing, Redwood Inference
From: Harper Lane <harper.lane@devforum.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.inference>
Cc: DevForum Sponsorships <sponsorships@devforum.com>
Date: 2026-02-02T16:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: DevForum 2026 — sponsorship package and speaking availability

Hi Vivek — great to hear back and thanks for the internal alignment. We can accommodate the requests as follows:

- Keynote: we will extend to a 40-minute slot (30 + 10 Q&A). We’ll reflect the incremental $5,000 line in the SOW.
- Logo & visibility: Redwood will be listed as “Headliner — Lead Platform Sponsor” in the attendee app, and front-center-left on the stage backdrop. We’ll include a stage render in the final exhibit kit.
- Leads: we will provide daily CSV exports for app opt-ins during show days; full post-event export for others. DPA amendment will be attached to the contract.

Next steps: we’ll issue a redline-ready SOW with the fee and the DPA attached. Please confirm that Redwood accepts the 40-minute slot and we’ll send the contract for signature (DocuSign link will follow).

Looking forward to having Redwood as a headliner — happy to get the SOW to you today.

Best,
Harper Lane
Senior Sponsorship Manager, DevForum
